name: OmaMELCloud
author: Gregor Skrt
description: Control your Mitsubishi Electric MELCloud air conditioners from the Omarchy bar: power, mode, target temperature, fan speed, and vane direction, with compressor-protection safeguards and support for switching between multiple units.

barWidget.description: Shows room and target temperature and power state for your MELCloud air conditioner(s), with power, mode, target temperature, fan speed, and vane controls, plus a device picker if your account has more than one unit.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to poll MELCloud in the background for the device's state, separate from opening the panel (which always refreshes). Defaults to 900s (15 minutes), matching Home Assistant's own MELCloud integration -- MELCloud has rate-limited and temporarily locked accounts that polled more aggressively than this. Floored at 180s.
